evidence.excerpt: Apptronik Accelerates Commercialization of Humanoid Robots with Key Executive Hires from Top Tech Giants ‍ Former Waymo, Boston Dynamics, and Amazon Leaders Join Apptronik; Daniel Chu appointed as Chief Product Officer, alongside senior leaders across software, services, marketing, and people operations ‍ Austin, Texas – April 28, 2026 – AI-powered robotics company Apptronik today announced a series of strategic executive hires to accelerate its next phase of growth and commercialization. The new leadership team brings together talent from some of the world’s most advanced technology organizations, including Waymo, Boston Dynamics, and Amazon. This expansion follows Apptronik’s landmark $935M Series A funding round and comes as the company prepares to unveil its highly anticipated new humanoid robot. ‍ Daniel Chu Joins as Chief Product Officer Daniel Chu joins Apptronik as Chief Product Officer, bringing more than two decades of experience building and scaling transformative technology products, at the intersection of human need and machine intelligence.
